# LuxeMia

> Indian ethnic wear storefront. The public shopping website is https://luxemia.shop. Shopify provides the product catalog, cart, and checkout behind this custom storefront.

## Shop and product discovery

- [All collections](https://luxemia.shop/collections)
- [New arrivals](https://luxemia.shop/new-arrivals)
- [Sarees](https://luxemia.shop/sarees)
- [Lehengas](https://luxemia.shop/lehengas)
- [Suits](https://luxemia.shop/suits)
- [Menswear](https://luxemia.shop/menswear)
- [Product and page sitemap](https://luxemia.shop/sitemap.xml)
- [Merchant product feed](https://luxemia.shop/merchant-feed.xml)
- [Organic product search feed, gzip JSONL](https://luxemia.shop/openai-search-products.jsonl.gz)

Product pages use https://luxemia.shop/product/{handle}. The compatibility route /products/{handle} redirects to the corresponding product page. Read the current product page for price, availability, images, fabric, sizing, and purchasing options. Variant choices can affect price and availability.

## Policies and support

- [Shipping](https://luxemia.shop/shipping)
- [Returns](https://luxemia.shop/returns)
- [Privacy](https://luxemia.shop/privacy)
- [Terms](https://luxemia.shop/terms)
- [Contact](https://luxemia.shop/contact)

Use the published policies and checkout for current shipping costs, delivery estimates, and return conditions. Checkout links generated by the storefront can use Shopify's store domain. This document describes the public storefront; it does not advertise a UCP or MCP endpoint on luxemia.shop.
